changes: Stopping from the menu bar no longer loses the session — it is committed to history
Stopping while paused no longer subtracts the pause twice
Visual report no longer crashes when every task in the period is zero-length
Task names starting with '=' are written as text, not as Excel formulas
A /sleep deadline no longer outlives its session
Corrupt state, history or config files no longer take the app or the widget down
28 MB smaller: Pillow, tkinter/Tcl/Tk and the CPython test suite were dead weight
/help now matches what the app actually does
